clos.title: Introduction
clos.statement: Understand foundations of finance in business with coverage of major objectives and roles in business decision, relationship between firm and agents in the operating environment.

topics.title: Role of Finance in a Firm
Goal of Financial Management of a Firm

clos.title: Time Value of Money
clos.statement: Apply time value of money concept in business problems and others.

clos.title: Capital Budgeting
clos.statement: Apply capital budgeting technique in evaluating projects and to select the best project.

clos.title: Risk and Return
clos.statement: Calculate return and measured risk of securities using concept of CAPM and compare various efficiency category of the financial market.

topics.title: Standard Deviation and Co-efficient of Variation

clos.title: Valuation
clos.statement: Understand the concept of financial securities and apply valuations techniques in pricing securities.

clos.title: Working Capital Management
clos.statement: Compare inventory management techniques and evaluate short-term financing instruments.

clos.statement: Understand the sources of long-term financing.
